newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat in dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat in dull trading.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed flat at 42.5250/5300 to the dollar in yet another dull interbank session on Sunday, dealers said.
Taka was quoted at 42.5250/5400 per dollar in early trade but edged up later amid scant buying of the greenback.
"Major players were absent in the market. Only a few private banks bought a small amount (of dollar)," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates ended at 6.0 to 6.5 percent, slightly down from Saturday's 6.0-7.0 percent. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
